scripts.db:init: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { pool } = require('./src/config/db'); const fs = require('fs'); const sql = fs.readFileSync('./database/schema.sql', 'utf8'); pool.query(sql).then(() => { console.log('Database initialized successfully'); pool.end(); }).catch(err => { console.error('Database initialization failed:', err.message); pool.end(); process.exit(1); });"
